title: snmp-interfaces
author: Unknown
description: Attempts to enumerate network interfaces through SNMP. This script can also be run during Nmap's pre-scanning phase and can attempt to add the SNMP server's interface addresses to the target list. The script argument snmp-interfaces.host is required to know what host to probe. To specify a port for the SNMP server other than 161, use snmp-interfaces.port. When run in this way, the script's output tells how many new targets were successfully added.
